hip abductor muscles

Clinical usage

The patient demonstrates abnormal muscle response.

Daily-use sentences

(from abashment, abasement, abhorrence)

Supportive phrasing

Counselling is provided to support mental well-being.

Daily-use sentences

Regular supported positioning prevents pressure sores.
